name: Ricardo Oliveira
bio:
Ricardo Oliveira is a seasoned PR Officer with a career spanning over three decades in motorsport. Born and raised in São Paulo, his passion for racing ignited at a young age, attending countless Formula One Brazilian Grand Prix races at Interlagos. Ricardo began his career in journalism, covering local racing events before transitioning to team communications. He believes in crafting authentic narratives that resonate with fans, sponsors, and the media. His meticulous approach and deep understanding of the sport's intricacies have earned him a reputation as a reliable and effective PR strategist. 

Over the years, Ricardo has worked with several high-profile drivers and teams, navigating complex situations with grace and professionalism. He's known for his ability to anticipate potential PR pitfalls and develop proactive strategies to mitigate risks. At Arrow McLaren, he aims to elevate the team's profile, fostering a strong connection with its global fanbase and solidifying its position as a leading force in motorsport. His distinctive approach involves merging traditional PR methods with innovative digital strategies, ensuring maximum reach and engagement.

physical.hairStyle: Short, neatly combed back with a slight receding hairline
physical.description: Ricardo is a stocky man of average height with a warm, approachable demeanor.

quirks: Insists on using a vintage typewriter for drafting press releases.
Always carries a lucky charm from his favorite race at Interlagos.
Has a habit of meticulously cleaning his glasses every hour.
